RULES.md.text:
# Agent Workflow Rules

`.agents/RULES.md` is the neutral, global source of truth for workflow rules
shared by configured agents.

Before the first response or action:

1. Read every Markdown file under `.agents/rules/` in lexical order.
2. Read `.agents/memory/MEMORY.md` and only the entries relevant to the task.
3. Read `.agents/overlays/<current-agent>/RULES.md` when it exists.

Use the portable `plan-review` skill to critique non-trivial implementation
plans before implementation and `code-review` to critique non-trivial pending
changes before reporting completion or integration. The current agent performs
each review unless the user explicitly requests delegation and the active
agent supports it. Agent overlays may describe invocation mechanics but never
replace the portable review contracts.

memory/MEMORY.md.text:
# Global Memory Index

Add durable global notes under the typed `feedback/`, `user/`, and `reference/` directories, then index them here.

When `~/.agents/memory/IMPORTED.md` exists, use it as the provenance index for
notes imported from legacy agent setups.

rules/claude-shared-rules-from-claude.md.text:
# Shared working rules

Preserve unrelated edits, verify changes, and keep reusable knowledge in
portable workflow directories.

skills/backlog/SKILL.md.text:
---
name: backlog
description: Refresh a portable backlog from durable project notes.
---

Collect deferred work, merge duplicate entries, and keep stable identifiers.

skills/feedback/SKILL.md.text:
---
name: feedback
description: Summarize review feedback that requires a response.
---

Group feedback by change, distinguish questions from blockers, and suggest next actions.

skills/init-claude/SKILL.md.text:
---
name: init-claude
description: Set up the portable agent workflow for a selected project.
---

Create the neutral workflow layout and selected agent entrypoints.

skills/morning/SKILL.md.text:
---
name: morning
description: Produce a concise morning brief from available work items.
---

Summarize urgent changes, reviews, feedback, and recommended next actions.

skills/my-reviews/SKILL.md.text:
---
name: my-reviews
description: Summarize changes awaiting the user's review.
---

List review requests by urgency with the latest relevant context.

skills/pick/SKILL.md.text:
---
name: pick
description: Select a backlog item and prepare its implementation context.
---

Resolve the requested item, gather relevant context, and draft the next plan.

skills/tasks/SKILL.md.text:
---
name: tasks
description: Summarize task changes from available work-item data.
---

Render task updates with stable identifiers, state changes, and next actions.

skills/wrap/SKILL.md.text:
---
name: wrap
description: Write an end-of-session note with durable context.
---

Record the summary, changes, decisions, challenges, and open threads.
